svg.title: ~108 defects caught in the chain, 4 reached the owner
svg.desc: Layers in order before the owner. Analysis check, before the code: 66 significant gaps in 14 checks (a different unit, outside the funnel). Tester: 71 red rounds, product-red in 36 of 89 tasks; 112 enter, 41 pass on. Reviewer: 31 rejected rounds for a code defect, rejected 43 of 89 tasks; 10 pass on. Security reviewer: 5 security rounds, findings in 5 of 8 security tasks; 5 pass on. Train: 0-1 product defect, counted as 1; 4 pass on. Owner after acceptance: 4 defects every role missed, about 4 % of ~108 caught in the chain. Widths count defect-rounds; a round is not exactly one defect.
